subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should the repository accept these 14 upgraded action revisions as one reviewed trust-boundary change, or require the credential-bearing and release actions to land separately?
rationale: The patch is mechanically narrow, but several upgraded actions receive secrets or write permissions, and the current dependency-verification gate is not green; repository owner intent is required to accept or narrow that supply-chain review scope.

options.title: Verify and land together
options.body: Confirm every new SHA maps to its intended upstream release and require a refreshed exact-head run of the affected workflow and security gates before merging the grouped update.

options.title: Split privileged actions
options.body: Move app-token, Codex, CodeQL, Docker login/build-push, and release action updates into smaller PRs with owners and proof specific to each trust boundary.

options.title: Pause and regenerate
options.body: Close or supersede this branch if Dependabot cannot rebase it, then regenerate the update from current main with stable checks and accessible provenance.

recommendation.title: Verify and land together
recommendation.body: Confirm every new SHA maps to its intended upstream release and require a refreshed exact-head run of the affected workflow and security gates before merging the grouped update.

likelyOwner.reason: The workflow history shows broad ownership of prior action modernization, Node runtime changes, docs-agent automation, and Docker release hardening.
